summary: Magnitude is a self‑optimizing inference engine that dynamically selects models and tunes runtime parameters for agentic workloads. It runs locally via a Rust core with a Python SDK, CLI, and REST API, and requires an API key for some back‑ends. It is suited for developers needing fast, hybrid local/cloud inference in agent pipelines, offering quick one‑time kernel tuning as its standout strength while the limited test coverage (1/3 passed) is a clear caveat.

github.description: Open source inference engine for agents that optimizes itself for your exact hardware. Compiles and tunes its kernels on your device, so open models run up to 2x faster than llama.cpp. Works on Apple Silicon, NVIDIA, AMD, or just a CPU.
